description: This script reads command-line arguments pointing to test scripts, opens output files for writing, and processes associated expectation and test files within a 'chainlint' directory. It adjusts line numbers in expectation files based on an offset and copies relevant test lines while skipping lines marked with '# LINT:'.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script execution that handles argument parsing, file operations, and processing of test and expectation files.
